subject.title: Discord turns can be missed or finish silently across gateway restart/recovery on 2026.6.10

question: Should this broad report stay open as the parent tracker for the remaining Discord restart/recovery reliability work, or should maintainers split it now across the existing focused issues and partial merged fixes?
rationale: The report includes multiple real failure classes and two partial fixes have landed, but maintainer intent is needed to decide whether one parent issue should coordinate the remaining behavior or whether the focused issues are now the canonical trackers.

options.title: Keep as parent tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until the remaining inbound catch-up, final delivery, and cron/task recovery questions are either fixed or explicitly split into linked canonical issues.

options.title: Split into focused issues
options.body: Move the unique v2026.6.10 evidence into the focused remaining issues and then close this broad report as superseded by those canonical trackers.

options.title: Close after release proof
options.body: Wait for a release that contains the current partial fixes, then close only if live Discord restart proof shows the remaining symptoms no longer reproduce.

recommendation.title: Keep as parent tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the remaining inbound catch-up, final delivery, and cron/task recovery questions are either fixed or explicitly split into linked canonical issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses durable delivery, Discord channel behavior, restart recovery, and issue-cluster ownership; steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across those surfaces.
